name: [Pre-Alpha] [🎮 x Open Test] Z-UNIVERSE
desc:
Open World PVE Sandbox RPG based off of the works of Akria Toriyama. 

Join the game with custom lore and nods to fan works such as Dragon Ball Ultra Vegetto and Fanfictions From the likes of MajorDragon, SmugStick, and Salad Saiyan.

Keyboard and Mouse Only 

Controls:
L - Lock on
M1 - Light Attack
M2 - Heavy Attack
Z - Vanish/Dodge
F - Block
F + Hold LMB [M1] (Parry)
B - Execute
H - Toggle Simple Numbers
Minus - Toggle UI
